results.title: The runaway 10-year yield is triggering a bad memory for investors
results.snippet: 2. Best 0% APR Cards. 2. Best High-Yield Savings. # The runaway 10-year yield is triggering a bad memory for investors. The fresh rip in the 10-year US Treasury yield (^TNX) is triggering a brutal memory for many investors. They aren't necessarily admitting it, as seen in the stock market's surprising resilience. The last time the US 10-year bond yield was this high was July 2007. And to suggest we are on the cusp of a stock market crash simply because yields are back to 2007 levels would be reckless. The 10-year Treasury yield climbed as high as 5.12% on Wednesday, its highest level since 2007.
